purpose: Authoritative Vantia build state, artifacts and audit trail. This branch is an orphan: it shares no history with `main` and must never be merged into it.
notes: `.vantia/` is gitignored on `main`; staging here requires `git add -f`.
`git merge-base main vantia-state` must exit non-zero. If it exits zero the isolation guarantee is broken.
Never hand-edit state.json — use engine.state_manager so the lock, backup, hash chain and mirror update atomically.
A corrupt state file is intentional: it fails loudly rather than being silently repaired. Recover with `git checkout vantia-state -- .vantia/state/state.json`.
